exposure: Different classification references for plagiocephaly severity using DTD
Different classification references for plagiocephaly severity using CVAi
outcome: Agreement between severity level classifications of plagiocephaly
cohort: The study included 50 babies with a possible diagnosis of plagiocephaly.
finding: Agreement between the plagiocephaly classifications using DTD and CVAi measurements ranged from weak to moderate across all references found in the literature.
cross-section timing: Measurements were obtained at a single point in time for babies with a possible diagnosis of plagiocephaly.
